description: Espaces de stationnement des VNILSSA (véhicules non immatriculés en libre-service sans ancrage) is a dataset listed in City of Montréal open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Ville de Montréal. Cet ensemble de données présente la localisation géographique des espaces de stationnement autorisés pour les véhicules non immatriculés en libre-service sans ancrage (VNILSSA) sur le territoire de la Ville de Montréal. Coverage: Montréal. The portal files it under the publisher Ville de Montréal. Its tags are Mobilité, SUM, Stationnement, Transport, Trottinette. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2025-02-26 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-montreal-portal.
